stem: Voltmarkt's finance director asks about Business Care, Voltmarkt's device-support subscription for small offices: "How much gross profit do we expect from a typical business over the whole time it stays with us?" Which calculation answers this question?

options.text: ARPA × gross margin / monthly logo churn rate
100 × a cohort's MRR now / its MRR a year ago
Sales and marketing cost / (new MRR × gross margin)
